agency: Georgia Department of Community Affairs (DCA), Georgia Dream

programs.name: Georgia Dream Homeownership Program

amount.text: up to $10,000 (Peach Plus announcement: the lesser of 3.5% of the purchase price or $10,000; loan program page: the lesser of 5% or $10,000)

programs.repayment: 0% interest, no monthly payment, second lien due when you sell, refinance or no longer occupy the home as your primary residence
programs.firstTimeNote: Peach Plus variant has higher limits; Peach Select for veterans
programs.buyerContribution: $1,000 minimum of own funds or documented gift

incomeLimit.text: Atlanta metro $120,439 (1-2 persons) / $138,505 (3+); Athens MSA $101,429 / $116,644; all other counties $92,000 / $105,800 — table marked effective July 8, 2024, the latest shown by DCA

priceLimit.text: $425,000 Atlanta metro, $375,000 Athens MSA, $360,000 all other counties (same 2024 table)

programs.note: DCA site unreachable from our network; figures from the official pages' indexed text; percentage conflicts between two DCA pages, only the $10,000 cap is used
